tasks.name: 创建笔记模型
创建笔记API
创建笔记前端页面
实现笔记搜索功能
优化笔记组织功能

T1.implementation_approach: Design a database model with fields like title, content, timestamp, and tags to store note information.
T1.notes: Ensure the model supports scalability and flexibility for future features.

T2.implementation_approach: Develop RESTful APIs for CRUD operations on notes, including endpoints for creating, reading, updating, and deleting notes.
T2.notes: Use proper authentication and validation for secure API access.

T3.implementation_approach: Create a responsive frontend page using a framework like React or Vue.js to display, create, and edit notes.
T3.notes: Focus on user-friendly design and seamless interaction with the backend API.

T4.implementation_approach: Implement a search feature using full-text search or keyword matching to filter notes based on title or content.
T4.notes: Consider optimizing search performance for large datasets.

T5.implementation_approach: Introduce features like categorization, tagging, or folder structures to better organize notes.
T5.notes: Ensure the organization system is intuitive and supports easy navigation.
